info.title: Gmail API - Messages and Drafts
info.description: Gmail REST API endpoints for the authenticated user's mailbox (userId is always "me"). Search messages via GET /users/me/messages (returns only id and threadId; follow up with GET /users/me/messages/{id} for content). Read one message via GET /users/me/messages/{id}. Create a draft via POST /users/me/drafts. Draft POST body is { message: { raw } } where raw is a base64url-encoded RFC 2822 email (headers To/Subject/Content-Type, a blank line, then the body).

get.description: Searches the authenticated user's mailbox and returns a page of matching message ids and threadIds only. Use the q parameter with Gmail search syntax (same as the Gmail search box), e.g. "from:alice@example.com newer_than:7d", "subject:invoice has:attachment", "is:unread label:inbox", "after:2026/09/01 before:2026/09/30". Results contain no subject, sender, or body. Call Get message by ID for each id you need to read. Use nextPageToken with pageToken to fetch more results.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Gmail search query. Supports the same operators as the Gmail search box: from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, is:unread, label:, newer_than:7d, older_than:1m, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, filename:, and free text.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return per page. Default 100, maximum 500. Prefer a small value (10-25) when you will read each message afterwards.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Page token from a previous response's nextPageToken to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: labelIds
parameters.description: Only return messages with this label ID. Common system labels: INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SPAM, TRASH.

parameters.name: includeSpamTrash
parameters.description: Include messages from SPAM and TRASH in the results. Default false.

200.description: A page of matching message references

nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page of results, if any.

get.description: Gets a single message from the authenticated user's mailbox by its id (from Search messages). With format=full (default) the response includes headers (From, To, Subject, Date) in payload.headers, a short snippet, and the MIME tree in payload.parts. Body text is base64url-encoded in payload.body.data or payload.parts[].body.data; decode it to read. File attachments appear as parts with a filename and payload.parts[].body.attachmentId; pass that attachmentId together with the part's mimeType and filename to GMAIL_GET_ATTACHMENT_CONTENT to read the file. Use format=metadata with metadataHeaders to fetch only headers.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The immutable ID of the message, as returned by Search messages.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. full: headers, snippet and full MIME payload (default). metadata: headers and snippet only, no body. minimal: id, threadId, labelIds and snippet only. raw: entire RFC 2822 message base64url-encoded in the raw field.

parameters.name: metadataHeaders
parameters.description: Comma-separated header names to include when format=metadata, e.g. From,To,Subject,Date.

post.description: Creates a new draft in the authenticated user's mailbox without sending it. The body must be { message: { raw } } where raw is the complete RFC 2822 email encoded as base64url (URL-safe alphabet: '-' and '_' instead of '+' and '/', padding optional). Build the email as header lines separated by CRLF, then a blank line, then the body. Example before encoding: "To: recipient@example.com Subject: Hello Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8 Hello". Add Cc: and Bcc: header lines for additional recipients. Optionally set message.threadId to attach the draft to an existing thread (also include In-Reply-To and References headers for a proper reply).

raw.description: Base64url-encoded RFC 2822 email including To, Subject and Content-Type headers, a blank line, and the body. Use text/plain or text/html in Content-Type to match the body.

threadId.description: Optional. ID of an existing thread to attach the draft to (for replies).

id.description: The immutable ID of the draft.

snippet.description: Short plain-text preview of the message body.

internalDate.description: Internal message creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

raw.description: Base64url-encoded RFC 2822 message. Only present when format=raw.

attachmentId.description: Present when the part is an attachment stored separately. Use with GMAIL_GET_ATTACHMENT_CONTENT.

data.description: Base64url-encoded part content; present for inline text bodies.

parts.description: Child MIME parts for multipart messages.

items.description: Nested MessagePart with the same shape as the parent.
